description: This file defines a React component 'LoadingSkeleton' and several related auxiliary components and hooks for displaying various loading placeholders (skeletons) in a web application's UI, such as for cards, lists, tables, metrics, and charts.

methods.name: LoadingSkeleton
methods.description: A React functional component that renders different types of skeleton loading placeholders based on the 'variant' prop (card, list, table, metrics, chart). It supports multiple variants for various UI patterns and includes an animated option.

methods.name: MCPServerListSkeleton
methods.description: A specific skeleton component for a server list, rendering the 'list' variant with a configurable count.

methods.name: MCPMetricsSkeleton
methods.description: A skeleton component for metrics display, using the 'metrics' variant.

methods.name: MCPOverviewSkeleton
methods.description: A composite skeleton component for a dashboard overview, including card, metrics, and list skeletons.

methods.name: MCPToolsSkeleton
methods.description: A skeleton component used in a tools section, rendering two cards side by side.

methods.name: LoadingWrapper
methods.description: A React component that conditionally renders a skeleton or the loaded children/content based on the 'loading' boolean prop.

methods.name: useLoadingState
methods.description: A custom React hook that manages loading state, providing a method 'withLoading' to wrap async functions with automatic loading state toggling.
